mapper.select: SELECT tp.project_id AS projectId, tp.owner_id AS ownerId, tp.title AS title, tp.location AS location, tp.start_date AS startDate, tp.end_date AS endDate, tp.project_type AS projectType, tp.created_at AS createdAt, tp.thumbnail AS thumbnail FROM travel_project tp LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON tp.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId}
